title: Karyagin's Raid
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Karyagin's Raid", at revision 1380299674, opens: "Karyagin's raid, also known as the Persian campaign of Colonel Karyagin, and as the Qarabagh-Ganjeh campaign in Iranian sources, was a military campaign that took place during the Russo-Persian War (1804-1813)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18408391, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1805 battle between Russia and Persia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
